The following is a rant on grammar. Skip if you're not interested.

TL;DR - Once we as a community begin to accept mediocrity as an acceptable standard, the quality of our content will diminish from there on out and we'll never rise to our full potential. Accept 100% effort or nothing at all.

This is a perfect example of why Oxford commas are important. The way it's currently written implies that he's talking to someone named "feelings and emotions." There should be a comma between "feelings" and "and." Also, the phrase "who do so little for you" should be between commas.

I know you didn't create it. I'm just stating it because often times, others don't. Proper grammar is important. Many people have already rolled their eyes and continued on by this point, but it really is. It's incredibly difficult for people to take something seriously if the creator isn't going to take the time to use proper grammar. That's just lazy. Let's say the person just didn't know. Okay, then I'm even less likely to truly take to heart what some ignorant person has to say. If they don't know what they're talking about when it comes to simple grammar, then they probably have no idea what they're talking about in general.

"But Phivex, are you saying this quote is crap and you should let people bother you?"

Nope not at all. In fact, I love this quote. The issue I have is the creator of this image screwed up the quote. Because of that, I have no intention of ever sharing the image, because then I look like a fool that accepts bad grammar and mediocrity and being okay. No. Fuck that. Either do it right or do something else.

Sorry. I know this kind of turned into a rant, but many people don't realize how important grammar is. They think it's just some pretentious way to communicate. Fuck those people. It's called being educated and those people probably didn't take their education seriously.

I feel as if there has become this idea on Voat to hate grammar nazi's and that's somewhat understandable because often times they're douches, but here's the thing. Once we as a community begin to accept mediocrity as an acceptable standard, the quality of our content will diminish from there on out and we'll never rise to our full potential. Accept 100% effort or nothing at all.

I'm sure there is at least one person out there perusing my rant for grammatical errors and that's fine. Please correct me. I'm happy to learn from my mistakes.
